CREATE TABLE "public"."idempotency_keys" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "endpoint" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "manager_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "response" json NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."invoice_balance_transfers" (
  "amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "manager_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "source_invoice_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "target_invoice_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "transferred_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."invoice_items" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "invoice_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "property_charge_id" uuid,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "total_amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "unit_amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."invoices" (
  "amount_paid" numeric NOT NULL,
  "balance_due" numeric NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "due_date" date NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "invoice_number" text NOT NULL,
  "issue_date" date NOT NULL,
  "manager_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "property_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "tenancy_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "total_amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payment_allocations" (
  "allocated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "invoice_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "manager_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "payment_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payments" (
  "amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "invoice_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "manager_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "payment_date" date NOT NULL,
  "payment_method" text NOT NULL,
  "property_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "reference_number" text,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."properties" (
  "address_line_1" text NOT NULL,
  "address_line_2" text,
  "city" text NOT NULL,
  "country" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'KES' NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "manager_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "monthly_rent" numeric NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "postal_code" text,
  "state" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."property_charges" (
  "amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "billing_frequency" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool NOT NULL,
  "manager_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "property_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."receipts" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "issued_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "manager_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "payment_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "receipt_number" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tenancies" (
  "assigned_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "end_date" date,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "manager_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "monthly_rent" numeric NOT NULL,
  "property_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "property_unit" text NOT NULL,
  "start_date" date NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "unassigned_at" timestamptz,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tenants" (
  "address" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "emergency_contact_name" text,
  "emergency_contact_phone" text,
  "first_name" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "last_name" text NOT NULL,
  "manager_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "phone" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "address" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "first_name" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "last_name" text NOT NULL,
  "organization" text,
  "password_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'administrator' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
